segments.text: What if Gojo lost his powers for a day? The confidence stays. The backup plan has vanished.
segments.label: THE CONFIDENCE STILL WORKS

segments.text: This hypothetical disables his technique for twenty-four hours. No upgrade. Use the syllabus.
segments.label: ONE INVENTED BAD DAY

segments.text: Yuji suggests hiding him. Gojo calls it a lesson. My guy, impressive rebrand for embarrassment.
segments.label: YUJI GETS WORRIED

segments.text: Megumi asks who knows he's vulnerable. Announcing it? A beautifully stupid marketing campaign.
segments.label: MEGUMI READS THE ROOM

segments.text: Gojo keeps experience and judgment. We removed a technique, not his brain. No personality factory reset.
segments.label: POWER IS NOT ALL HE KNOWS

segments.text: They change the objective. Evacuate people, limit exposure, avoid direct fights. Reach tomorrow intact.
segments.label: CHANGE THE OBJECTIVE

segments.text: Yuji wants to rescue everyone alone. Strong instincts, brother. Terrible delivery policy for handing yourself to enemies.
segments.label: NO HEROIC DETOUR

segments.text: A threat appears. Instead of overpowering it, they use a decoy and escape route.
segments.label: THE WRONG BATTLE

segments.text: Megumi handles the route. Yuji moves people. Gojo calls timing. Students become participants, not spectators.
segments.label: THE PLAN NEEDS EVERYBODY

segments.text: Gojo must trust his teaching. Incredible. Education has reached its terrifying practical application. Somebody check the syllabus.
segments.label: THE TEACHER HAS TO TRUST

segments.text: The powers return tomorrow. The lesson remains: your team shouldn't collapse because its strongest member struggles.
segments.label: THE CLOCK IS NOT THE STORY

segments.text: Gojo claims everything was intentional. Megumi requests the lesson plan. The receipts have entered the domain, undefeated.
segments.label: THE DEBRIEF IS COOKED
